items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 07 August 2026 at 12:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving high centred near the southwest of Cornwall with an associated ridge to the North Sea. Low near the south of Iceland.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, backing south or southwest this afternoon. Decreasing 3 or 4 overnight, but occasionally 5 again tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, soon increasing mainly 4 or 5 Saturday afternoon for a time but variable 3 or less in the southeast of the area. Settling west or southwest in all waters overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then occasional rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate later.
